@ Master Plan Implementation
1. Security Hardening: Screenshots are now encrypted in-place using Fernet. They are only decrypted in memory for OCR/AI. I also
added a Secret Scanner that flags and deletes captures if they contain API keys or tokens.
2. LinkedIn & Articles: Added specialized prompt logic for high-value LinkedIn posts and long-form technical articles (Markdown).
3. RLHF Tone Memory: You can now rate posts (1-5 stars) via the API. High-rated posts are automatically injected into future
prompts as "few-shot" examples to match your voice.
4. Engagement Tracking: A new background worker fetches real-world likes/retweets from the X API 24 hours after you publish,
further boosting the "weight" of successful posts in the AI's memory.
5. Codebase Context: The Article generator now reads your project's README and file structure to provide deep technical context.
6. Thread Splitter: An intelligent utility that breaks long posts into numbered 1/, 2/ threads at sentence boundaries.
@ How to Test
1. Auth: On startup, look for [Auth] Session Token: <UUID> in the terminal. All API calls now require this token in the
X-Session-Token header for security.
2. Encryption: Trigger a capture (Ctrl+Shift+P), then try to open the image in storage/data/screenshots. It will be unreadable
(encrypted).
3. Dashboard: Open http://127.0.0.1:8000. You will see the new LinkedIn tab and "Write Article" options.
4. Maintenance: The app now runs a cleanup on startup that deletes screenshots older than 24 hours.
To push these changes to GitHub, use:
git push origin main
